museum_aaa_test_cohort_wave4.name: Endless Museum — Vertical Rooms and Productive Space
museum_aaa_test_cohort_wave4.truth: A ceiling, an operating face, and an output runway are all placement rules.
museum_aaa_test_cohort_wave4.qfep_connection: Bodies, operations, outputs, and vertical scale negotiate distinct spatial claims through one inspectable contract layer.
museum_aaa_test_cohort_wave4.description: Ten candidates test self-supporting cabinets, wall instruments, working surfaces, productive runways, and monumental computational environments.
learning_objectives: Distinguish a self-supporting apparatus from an artifact that needs a museum host
Read frontal, orbital, directional-output, and two-sided circulation contracts
Include height in the negotiated spatial envelope
Recognize productive output as occupied museum territory
content: Museum_AAA_Test_Cohort_Wave4: ten candidates, ten visual passes, zero open reviews
